name: InboxFlow — More than a click

chapters.title:
What if emails
could do more?
chapters.narration: What if your emails could do more than get clicked?

chapters.title:
Turn emails
into experiences.
chapters.narration: Meet Inbox Flow. An interactive email platform for modern ecommerce. One workspace, from your first idea to your customer's next action.

chapters.title:
Your products.
Your workflow.
chapters.narration: Connect your commerce stack, sync your catalog, and bring your products into your email workflow. Here, Shopify and Klaviyo run in a clearly labeled local sandbox.

chapters.title:
Drag. Drop.
Make it yours.
chapters.narration: Start with a template. Drag in real catalog products. Add collections and subscription controls. Fine-tune your colors and typography. Then save, preview, and export a sandbox draft, from one flexible editor.

chapters.title:
More than
an email.
chapters.narration: A message becomes a starting point. Preview the email, then explore products and choose options in the hosted experience. Email support follows the inbox's actual capabilities. A browser fallback carries the rest.

chapters.title:
Shop smarter.
Stay in control.
chapters.narration: Choose a variant, adjust the quantity, and continue to sandbox checkout. Then manage the next subscription delivery, review the change, and confirm. Fewer unnecessary steps, with clear confirmation at every important moment.

chapters.title:
Little feedback.
Big difference.
chapters.narration: Collect a product review. Discover a customer's preferences. Their feedback is saved, and the profile updates in the sandbox.

chapters.title:
Meaningful moments,
measured.
chapters.narration: Back in the workspace, see recorded interactions, subscription actions, and confirmed sandbox orders. Ask focused questions with a transparent, rule-based analytics assistant. Real activity. Clear context.

chapters.title:
Make every email
a moment.
chapters.narration: Inbox Flow. Make every email a moment worth opening.

socialNarration: What if emails could do more? Build visually, with real products. Choose options. Continue to sandbox checkout. Manage your next delivery. Share feedback. Discover preferences. Then measure what happened. Inbox Flow. Explore the local demo.
